agent_notes: Government listing confirmed on both supplied NIRF 2025 Engineering and Management directory pages; both rows name the institution and Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh.
The official site identifies the campus at Morena Link Road, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh 474015.

The official central course catalogue and linked current course-of-study documents cover the active degree, diploma, certificate, doctoral and documented exit-award offerings; news and short-term events were excluded.

The catalogue is batch-specific: the batch-2025 PG document lists M.S. (Artificial Intelligence and Data Science), while the separate current MS document lists M.S. (Artificial Intelligence and Business Analytics); both official programme names were retained.

The batch-2025 PG catalogue uses M. Tech. (Wireless Networks and Computing) and M. Tech. (Information and Cyber Security); those current catalogue names were used where the generic programme page has older wording.

Normal TLS verification returned the exact proxy certificate error `curl: (60) SSL certificate problem: self signed certificate in certificate chain`; after confirming the expected official/search hostnames, public GET requests used curl --insecure. No credentials or private data were sent.
Search snippets were not used as verification evidence; all institution, district, description and programme facts came from the official website or supplied NIRF government listings.
